title: רב חנא בר יהודה

paragraphs: Rav Chana bar Yehudah, in Rava's name: Berakhot 48a, near the end, and 48b. However, Sanhedrin 77b has Rav Chinena bar Yehudah in Rav's name; so too the new Talmud editions. This requires investigation: perhaps it should read “in Rava's name.” One should not entertain the possibility that this is Chananyah ben Yehudah (see there), who is mentioned in Sifra and preceded the aforementioned man.
